tbesh_html:
Maachah = "oppression"
a city with a king that continued within Israel
Also named: ma.a.kha.ti (מַעֲכָתִי "Maacathite" H4602)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Maakah (or Maakath), the name of a place in Syria, also of a Mesopotamian, of three Israelites, and of four Israelitesses and one Syrian woman
strongs_1890.kjv_def: Maachah, Maachathites. See also H1038 (בֵּית מַעֲכָה).
